synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, anhydrous YbCl3 (3.84 g, 13.75 mmol) was suspended in heptane (200 cm3) and treated with anhydrous diethylamine (6.4 g, 87.5 mmol) for ca. 1 h at room temperature. The flask was connected to a vacuum line, carbon dioxide was introduced, and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 4 d with the total pressure kept at 1 atm with CO2. The colourless solid was filtered, washed several times with dichloromethane until the chloride test was negative, and dried in vacuo.

synthesis.procedure: Under conditions similar to the ethyl analogue, anhydrous YbCl3 (3.29 g, 11.8 mmol) was treated with anhydrous di-isopropylamine (7.20 g, 71.2 mmol) in toluene (100 cm3). After stirring for 3 h at room temperature under nitrogen, the mixture was treated with carbon dioxide and stirred for 4 d. The mixture was filtered and the solid extracted continuously under nitrogen with pentane. From the pentane extract, 4.51 g of colourless compound separated, was collected by filtration and dried in vacuo (solvent-free product).

Extraction of the product with n-heptane under reduced pressure gave crystals containing lattice heptane, which were used for the X-ray structure determination. synthesis.procedure: Anhydrous ErCl3 (1.66 g, 6.07 mmol) in heptane (100 cm3) was treated under nitrogen with di-isopropylamine (3.67 g, 36.3 mmol) for ca. 3 h. The mixture was then stirred under a carbon dioxide atmosphere for 2 d. After filtration, the complex crystallized from the filtrate on cooling to ca. 5 °C. The crude solid was extracted with heptane under reduced pressure to give a second crop (total yield 4.8%) as pink crystals.
